lines.text: Where will the nut end up? Starting underneath everything.
lines.phonemes: wˌɛɹ wɪl ðə nˈʌt ˈɛnd ˈʌp? stˈɑːɹɾɪŋ ˌʌndɚnˈiːθ ˈɛvɹɪθˌɪŋ.

lines.text: Shake a jar of mixed nuts, or a box of cereal, and the biggest pieces often rise to the top. Scientists call it the Brazil nut effect.
lines.phonemes: ʃˈeɪk ɐ dʒˈɑːɹ ʌv mˈɪkst nˈʌts, ɔːɹ ɐ bˈɑːks ʌv sˈiəɹɪəl, ænd ðə bˈɪɡɪst pˈiːsᵻz ˈɔfən ɹˈaɪz tə ðə tˈɑːp. sˈaɪəntɪsts kˈɔːl ɪt ðə bɹɐzˈɪl nˈʌt ɪfˈɛkt.

lines.text: You'd expect heavy things to sink. Yet it happens even when the big pieces are heavier.
lines.phonemes: juːd ɛkspˈɛkt hˈɛvi θˈɪŋz tə sˈɪŋk. jˈɛt ɪt hˈæpənz ˈiːvən wɛn ðə bˈɪɡ pˈiːsᵻz ɑːɹ hˈɛviɚ.

lines.text: Here is one reason. Each shake lifts the grains, and small ones tumble into the gaps under it. It can't fit down there, so it's propped up more each shake.
lines.phonemes: hˈɪɹ ɪz wˈʌn ɹˈiːzən. ˈiːtʃ ʃˈeɪk lˈɪfts ðə ɡɹˈeɪnz, ænd smˈɔːl wˈʌnz tˈʌmbəl ˌɪntʊ ðə ɡˈæps ˈʌndɚɹ ɪt. ɪt kˈænt fˈɪt dˌaʊn ðˈɛɹ, sˌoʊ ɪts pɹˈɑːpt ˌʌp mˈɔːɹ ˈiːtʃ ʃˈeɪk.

lines.text: Scientists have found several effects at work. Grains can flow in a loop, up the walls and down the middle. And in some jars, the big ones sink instead.
lines.phonemes: sˈaɪəntɪsts hæv fˈaʊnd sˈɛvɹəl ɪfˈɛkts æt wˈɜːk. ɡɹˈeɪnz kæn flˈoʊ ɪn ɐ lˈuːp, ˌʌp ðə wˈɔːlz ænd dˌaʊn ðə mˈɪdəl. ænd ɪn sˌʌm dʒˈɑːɹz, ðə bˈɪɡ wˈʌnz sˈɪŋk ɪnstˈɛd.

lines.text: Measure it: in this simulation, the big disc climbs from the bottom to near the top. It takes about ten seconds of shaking.
lines.phonemes: mˈɛʒɚɹ ɪt: ɪn ðɪs sˌɪmjʊlˈeɪʃən, ðə bˈɪɡ dˈɪsk klˈaɪmz fɹʌmðə bˈɑːɾəm tə nˌɪɹ ðə tˈɑːp. ɪt tˈeɪks ɐbˌaʊt tˈɛn sˈɛkəndz ʌv ʃˈeɪkɪŋ.

lines.text: Shaking doesn't just mix things. It often sorts them. Unpopped popcorn kernels sink in a bowl for a related reason.
lines.phonemes: ʃˈeɪkɪŋ dˈʌzənt dʒˈʌst mˈɪks θˈɪŋz. ɪɾ ˈɔfən sˈɔːɹts ðˌɛm. ʌnpˈɑːpt pˈɑːpkɔːɹn kˈɜːnəlz sˈɪŋk ɪn ɐ bˈoʊl fɚɹɚ ɹᵻlˈeɪɾᵻd ɹˈiːzən.

lines.text: Next: a coffee drop dries into a ring. Why not a blob?
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: ɐ kˈɔfi dɹˈɑːp dɹˈaɪz ˌɪntʊ ɐ ɹˈɪŋ. wˌaɪ nˌɑːɾə blˈɑːb?
